sanskrit_verse:
विहायोपानदुष्णीषं दक्षिणं पाणिम् उद्धरेत् ।
हिरण्यं गोशकृद् दर्भान् समादाय ऋतं वदेत् ॥
transliteration: vihāyopānaduṣṇīṣaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇim uddharet / hiraṇyaṃ gośakṛd darbhān samādāya ṛtaṃ vadet //
sph_interpretive_translation: Having cast off footwear and upper garment, raising the right hand, taking gold, cow-dung, and darbha grass, one shall speak Ṛta.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived through ritual readiness and conscious invocation.
Causation originates in alignment with Ṛta, not external compulsion.
Capacity-based responsibility requires bodily and material preparation.
Restoration logic necessitates precise sensory and symbolic engagement.
Consciousness alignment is enacted via prescribed physical and elemental acts.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent initiates judicial utterance THEN agent MUST have physically prepared by removing footwear and upper garment.
IF agent invokes Ṛta THEN agent MUST hold hiraṇya, gośakṛt, and darbhān simultaneously.
IF agent raises right hand THEN system SHALL register declarative intent as ontologically binding.
IF material requisites are absent THEN spoken declaration SHALL be void of juridical force.
IF bodily posture aligns with dharma-sūtra THEN consciousness-readiness is presumed.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court proceedings invoking foundational truth-telling (Ṛta), justices must perform the prescribed preparatory rites prior to issuing declarations. This ensures alignment with cosmic order and establishes threshold responsibility rooted in embodied discipline rather than abstract authority.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through correct physical and material setup, ensuring causal purity. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential embodiment leading to truthful speech. Responsibility is proportional to readiness; no fault accrues where incapacity is evident. Non-punitive reality prevails as misalignment results in ineffectiveness, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-perform rite until all elements—posture, substance, utterance—are aligned.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Agent repeats full preparatory sequence before re-speaking Ṛta.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Provide access to required materials and time for proper orientation.
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Confirm alignment between body, mind, and declared truth before acceptance.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands executed. Truth arises from embodied alignment. Justice restores capacity. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
